title: The bli (Boot Loader Interface) module makes grub2 export the
commit_message:
The bli (Boot Loader Interface) module makes grub2 export the
LoaderDevicePartUUID variable, which identifies the ESP from
where the bootloader was loaded. This is used by systemd
tools for disk autodiscovery.

https://systemd.io/BOOT_LOADER_INTERFACE/
